requirements.title: Binary and decimal rounding modes apply by operation radix
requirements.source: S17.4 p1; J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF483.
requirements.definition: The document specifies separate binary and decimal rounding modes affecting radix-two and radix-ten floating-point arithmetic; unqualified rounding-mode references for operations refer to the operation radix and other references to both modes.

pending.decimal-rounding-mode-affects-radix-ten-: Guard probe: profiled real kind X has RADIX(X)==10 and supports IEEE_UP plus IEEE_DOWN. TRUE branch: repeat the directed half-ulp addition for decimal X. FALSE branch: skip absent decimal support.
pending.unqualified-rounding-mode-reference-sele: Guard probe: one binary and one decimal supported kind are present. TRUE branch: setting the unqualified mode form is checked with GET for both radix modes, then each kind uses its own mode in the directed operation. FALSE branch: skip missing radix branch.

requirements.title: IEEE rounding constants correspond to 60559 attributes and IEEE_OTHER is processor dependent
requirements.source: S17.4 p2.rounding-attribute-mapping, p2.ieee-other-latitude; J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF483.
requirements.definition: IEEE_NEAREST, IEEE_TO_ZERO, IEEE_UP, IEEE_DOWN, and IEEE_AWAY correspond respectively to roundTiesToEven, roundTowardZero, roundTowardPositive, roundTowardNegative, and roundTiesToAway; IEEE_OTHER has no 60559 rounding-direction attribute and has processor-dependent effect if supported.

pending.ieee-away-ties-to-away-half-ulp-result: Guard probe: kind X supports IEEE_AWAY. TRUE branch: half-ulp ties on +1.0_X and -1.0_X round away from zero to adjacent representable values. FALSE branch: skip unsupported mode.
pending.ieee-other-effect-processor-dependent: No portable oracle fixes the arithmetic effect of IEEE_OTHER; fixtures may only assert set/get round-trip on processors reporting IEEE_SUPPORT_ROUNDING(IEEE_OTHER,X).

S17.4-002 IEEE rounding-direction fixture: after a radix-two support profile, volatile half-ulp additions at +/-1.0 verify NEAREST chooses the even endpoint 1.0, TO_ZERO rounds positive and negative half ulps toward zero, IEEE_UP rounds the positive half ulp upward and the negative one to -1.0, and IEEE_DOWN rounds the positive half ulp to 1.0 and the negative one downward to -(1.0+EPSILON).

requirements.definition: IEEE_GET_ROUNDING_MODE gets the rounding modes; the initial rounding modes are processor dependent.

requirements.title: Procedures preserve rounding modes on entry and restore them on return
requirements.source: S17.4 p5; J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF483.
requirements.definition: In a procedure other than IEEE_SET_ROUNDING_MODE or IEEE_SET_STATUS, the processor does not change rounding modes on entry and ensures they are the same on return as on entry.

TRUE branch: caller GET returns original IEEE_UP after return, then caller restores saved initial mode. FALSE branch: skip.
